segments.name: Insulin Pumps and Supplies
segments.description: Designs, develops and commercializes insulin pumps, supplies and diabetes technology for people with insulin-dependent diabetes worldwide.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company is organized as a single operating segment and therefore a single reportable segment: Insulin Pumps and Supplies.

revenueModel.text: The company sells pumps and single-use supplies through distributors and a direct sales force, with revenue also recognized through the pharmacy channel and third-party reimbursement.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company primarily sells its products through national and regional distributors in the United States on a non-exclusive basis, and through distribution partners internationally.
